# dbt-charts

> SQL-first dashboards for dbt.

Use these pages as compact context for coding agents and language models:

- Overview: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/intro
- Quickstart: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/get-started/quickstart
- Existing dbt project: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/get-started/existing-dbt-project
- Visualisation syntax: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/guides/visualisation-syntax
- Dashboard YAML: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/guides/dashboard-yaml
- CLI reference: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/reference/cli
- Examples gallery: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/examples/gallery
- Agents: https://kannandreams.github.io/dbt-charts/docs/ai-context/agents

Core workflow:

```bash
dbt build
dbt-charts doctor
dbt-charts render
dbt-charts dashboard
dbt-charts export
```
